verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a game engine editor could plausibly ship an AI assistant that connects to MCP servers. However, the evidence shows no MCP client capability. The probe finds no official Epic MCP work at all. The community MCP projects it cites (chongdashu/unreal-mcp, kvick-games/UnrealMCP) are servers that let outside agents drive Unreal, not a way for Unreal to consume MCP tools, and they are unmaintained. Remote Control and Python scripting are general automation surfaces, not MCP client support.
